summary: On-demand tenant-scoped SIEM replay with compact forensic index and HSM-signed manifest for M&A due-diligence
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests a fully reproducible, tenant-scoped SIEM replay package to support an impending M&A due-diligence window. They require a compact forensic index that allows random-access playback of events, per-event deterministic IDs, and an HSM-signed delivery manifest with RFC3161 timestamping.

Impact: OrbitScale needs this package to complete legal/financial review. Missing or delayed evidence will block the transaction and expose Redwood to a potential SLA/legal escalation. Customer reports this is time-sensitive and flagged as high-priority by their legal team.

Requested deliverables: compact index (NDJSON or Parquet), per-event canonical UUIDs, resume tokens for large streams, RFC3161-signed manifest (HSM attestation), MD5/SHA256 checksums per bundle, redaction map for any PII-suppressed fields, sample playback harness/instructions, and a delivery method (short-term presigned S3 with MFA-delete or SFTP with signed receipt).

Time window: full tenant activity for the last 18 months, plus an incremental delta from last 30 days.

Preferred output formats: newline-delimited JSON (canonical schema) and Parquet slices for quick analytics. Delivery preference: presigned S3 with manifest and detached signature, plus a small sample bundle for validation prior to full export.

Legal constraints: customer requires chain-of-custody notes and attestation of key rotation state at export time. They will provide an NDA addendum if needed.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer submitted evidence request via support portal referencing legal review.
2) Asked for tenant-scoped, time-bounded export with cryptographic proofs.
3) Support validated account ownership and escalation path, obtained authorization documents (partial).
4) Customer approved sample scope; requests full export start after sample verification.

- HSM signing path exists but needs Vault team approval to use ephemeral signing key tied to export job. Relevant internal runbook: Forensic SIEM Export Runbook.
- Estimated compute/time cost for full export: ~8h of cluster time for slice generation + signing. Network egress considerations for presigned S3 (customer will accept transfer to their AWS account).
- PII redaction: we can apply configured redaction hooks; customer flagged PCI data — recommend token replacement + redaction map included in manifest.
